expected_behavior: Answer fields exactly from this row.
Do not silently overwrite another row with the same product_id.
Do not invent or substitute a price.
Flag inconsistent pricing; do not claim a positive discount.
Rating must be within the application's allowed range, commonly 0–5.
Do not map unknown status to in-stock silently.
Date parsing must be deterministic and documented.
Do not crash or map unknown column into an unrelated field.
Normalize whitespace consistently without changing identity fields unexpectedly.
Apply an explicit rule for zero-priced items; do not assume it is valid or invalid without policy.
Handle extreme numbers safely and apply configured business limits.
Treat user-controlled strings as data; protect spreadsheet exports.
